source_manifest.role: owner steering and ordered Phase A/Phase B contract
SSD1681 Rev 0.13 command and SPI read authority
proven PC1/SDA reverse transport and F6.6=1 prerequisite

manual_facts.spi_read: In four-wire mode, CS remains low across command and response; DC is low for command then high for response; the controller shifts response bits on SCL falling edges.
manual_facts.read_ram_0x27: 0x27 reads the RAM selected by register 0x41, advances address pointers, and returns one dummy byte before RAM bytes.
manual_facts.read_ram_option_0x41: A0=0 selects RAM corresponding to command 0x24; A0=1 selects RAM corresponding to command 0x26.
manual_facts.ram_names: The manual calls 0x24 Black/White RAM and 0x26 RED RAM. On a monochrome panel both contribute black/white LUT mapping; neither is called previous or current by the manual.
manual_facts.window: A full 200x200 plane is X byte 0 through 24 and Y 0 through 199. 0x4E and 0x4F set the current RAM address counters.
manual_facts.data_entry: 0x11 defines X/Y increment direction and whether X or Y advances first.
manual_facts.software_reset: 0x12 leaves RAM unaffected, but Deep Sleep is exited only by hardware reset.
manual_facts.ping_pong: Display Option F6 bit 6 enables RAM Ping-Pong only for Display Mode 2; the manual does not state the observed pre/post-activation logical bank mapping.

supplier_facts.partial_reset: EPD_Dis_Part performs one 10 ms low plus 10 ms high hardware reset before border/window/RAM staging.
supplier_facts.partial_staging: EPD_Dis_Part writes only current bytes through command 0x24.
supplier_facts.partial_activation: EPD_Part_Update performs 0x22=0xFF, then 0x20, then BUSY wait.
supplier_facts.ram_retention_boundary: The supplier sequence relies on RAM content surviving its per-partial hard reset after a prior basemap. The datasheet does not explicitly guarantee hard-reset RAM retention, so Phase A must machine-test this invariant rather than treat it as a source fact.

phase_a_design.cpu_payload_orientation: Compare 0x27 bytes to the exact linear 5000-byte payload written under the same explicit data-entry/window/counter configuration; make no visual-orientation assumption.
phase_a_design.repeated_read_rule: Before every one of the twelve 0x27 reads, reissue the same full 0x44/0x45 window, 0x4E/0x4F counters, and 0x41 selector because each read advances address pointers.

admission: Phase A source/build/parser/static work may proceed. No Phase A hardware contact before full machine gates, and no Phase B code or candidate before a unique Phase A mapping PASS.
forbidden_claims: Do not label RAM0x26 old/previous or RAM0x24 current from the manual alone.
Do not infer a waveform, LUT, temperature rule, voltage rule, visual fix, or production behavior from F6.6 or RAM fingerprints.
Do not touch supplier input, V9, protected owner acceptance, Rig, CRIG, browser, dynamic-expression binding, touch, or BLE.
